issue.title: Dropped lit candlestick does not illuminate the dark room
issue.description: A lit candlestick only counts as a light source while it is in the player's inventory. If the player drops it in a dark room, it remains lit in the room but the room is still treated as pitch-black.
issue.expected_behavior: A lit candlestick dropped in the current dark room should continue to illuminate that room.
issue.observed_fault: After the lit candlestick is dropped in a dark room, the room remains pitch-black because light-source checks only consider the player's inventory.
reproduction: Pick up the candlestick and matches.
Execute `look` and observe that the room is still described as pitch-black.
issue.root_cause: `GameWorld.has_light_source` only checks lit items in `self.inventory`, so a lit item placed in the current room no longer contributes to `can_see()`.
